instruction.text: Worüber wird gesprochen? Wähle richtig aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>Some of my friends are very active on social media and post a lot. If I didn't know them, I would think they had completely different personalities judging by their online appearance.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6Us_chirp'>It's a natural process to try to fit in. However, I wonder if it is possible to fully stay true to yourself and at the same time belong to a group.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11_chirp'>I always wondered when the moment would come when I finally knew my true identity.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m5_chirp'>I feel like the people around me have a great influence on who I am and what I like or dislike.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10_chirp'>It is always possible to learn new skills, try new hobbies or find new interests and thereby change who you are.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>Mistakes we have made in the past often influence us in the present, hopefully teaching us to do better, but they don't define who we are.</voice>

parentTopic.title: Learning about my own and others’ identity
